newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: CREDIT LYONNAIS INITIATES ARGENTINE NORTEL AS BUY.
newsitem.headline: CREDIT LYONNAIS INITIATES ARGENTINE NORTEL AS BUY.

text.p: Credit Lyonnais said Thursday it initiated coverage of Argentina's Nortel Inversora SA, a holding company for Telecom Argentina, as buy.
Analyst Guadalupe Pasman wrote in a report that at current prices Nortel is trading at a 39 percent discount to its net asset value (NAV) "which we believe should narrow over time."
"Assuming that this discount narrows to a conservative 20 percent, our 12-month price target is $40 per ADS, representing 55.3 percent upside over current levels."

"On the other hand, in a pessimistic scenario where the current 39 percent discount is maintained over 12 months, the price should reach $30.51, an 18.5 percent increase over current levels," Pasman added.
Nortel owns 60 percent of the common stock of Telecom Argentina, which provides telecommunications services in northern Argentina.
Nortel is formed by Italy's STET (32.5 percent), France Telecom unit France Cable et Radio (32.5 percent), Argentine conglomerate Perez Companc (25 percent) and J.P. Morgan (10 percent).
